name: NIC Physics-of-Failure run-to-failure dataset -- generation configuration

paper.title: Physics-of-Failure-Guided Run-to-Failure Predictive Maintenance Dataset Generation and Analysis for Network Interface Cards
paper.venue: International Telecommunication Networks and Applications Conference (ITNAC 2026)

notation: Symbols and equation/table numbers refer to the paper. Parameters with scope 'per card' were drawn once per card from the stated distribution. config/card_parameters.csv lists, for all 200 cards, the realised value of every per-card parameter plus the per-environment sigma_T_C and the global constants Q_max_Gbps and Ea_SF_eV (repeated in every row); its column names are the keys used here.

experiment.environment_assignment: round-robin by card_id: card_id mod 3 = 0 -> hot, 1 -> cold, 2 -> controlled
experiment.workload: workload parameter distributions are identical in all environments

random_number_generation.generator: NumPy Generator with PCG64 bit generator (numpy.random.default_rng)
random_number_generation.noise_seed_use: hourly noise terms (eps_T, eps_I, eps_V, eps_theta, eps_Q) and the hourly burst load B
random_number_generation.note: seeds are recorded for provenance; the realised per-card parameters are listed in config/card_parameters.csv and the realised hourly values are the trajectories themselves

reference_stress_state.note: All acceleration factors equal 1 at the reference stress state (Sec. IV-D; reference values in Sec. V).

failure_and_censoring.failure_rule: failure at the first hour whose composite damage index reaches D_crit (Eq. 2); the card's trajectory ends at that row (failed_flag = 1)
failure_and_censoring.censoring_rule: cards whose DI_comp is still below D_crit after the last hour of the 43800-h horizon are right-censored: 43800 rows, no failure row

calibration.description: global degradation-rate constant; the only calibrated parameter (Sec. IV-D)
calibration.target: median lifetime of the controlled-environment population equals the design life (43800 h); censored cards count as +inf in the median
calibration.inverse_S_meaning: constant-reference-stress lifetime of a nominal card (zeta = 1)
calibration.returned_value: geometric midpoint of the final bracket
calibration.calibration_noise: calibration runs used the same noise seed as the released run but not the same sequence of noise draws, so their noise realisations differ
calibration.calibration_run_at_returned_S: 33 of 66 controlled cards fail within the horizon (median above 43800 h), 132 cards in total
calibration.released_run_at_returned_S: 34 of 66 controlled cards fail (median 43657 h), 134 cards in total

ambient_temperature.equation: Eq. (5): T_amb = T0 + Ay*sin(2*pi*t/8760) + Ad*sin(2*pi*(t mod 24)/24 - phi) + eps_T, eps_T ~ N(0, sigma_T^2)
ambient_temperature.yearly_phase: none: the yearly harmonic has zero phase for every card (all cards share one seasonal clock)

sigma_T_C.description: standard deviation of the hourly Gaussian noise eps_T (Table I)

traffic_load.equation: Eq. (6): L = clip(L_base + A_day*(1 + sin(2*pi*(t mod 24)/24 - pi/2))/2 + A_week*(1 + sin(2*pi*t/168))/2 + B, 0, 1), B ~ Gamma(shape=burst_k, scale=burst_theta)

burst_k.description: shape of the Gamma-distributed burst term B (drawn hourly)

burst_theta.description: scale of the Gamma-distributed burst term B

throughput.equation: Q = max(Q_max*L + eps_Q, 0), eps_Q ~ N(0, sigma_Q^2) (Sec. IV-A)

Q_max_Gbps.description: maximum throughput (same for every card; repeated in card_parameters.csv)

sigma_Q_Gbps.description: throughput noise standard deviation (same for every card)

current.equation: Eq. (7): I = I_idle + I_dyn*L + eps_I, eps_I ~ N(0, sigma_I^2)

sigma_I_A.description: current noise standard deviation (same for every card)

voltage.equation: Eq. (8): V = V_nom - alpha*L - beta*DI_comp(previous hour) + eps_V, eps_V ~ N(0, sigma_V^2)

sigma_V_V.description: voltage noise standard deviation (same for every card)

thermal_resistance.equation: Eq. (9): theta = theta0*(1 + gamma_theta*DI_comp(previous hour)) + eps_theta, eps_theta ~ N(0, sigma_theta^2)

sigma_theta_C_perW.description: thermal-resistance noise standard deviation (same for every card)

junction_temperature.equation: Eq. (10): T_j = clip(T_amb + theta*P, T_min, T_max)

thermal_excursion.definition: deltaT_24h = max - min of T_j over the trailing 24 hourly samples, current hour included (fewer samples during the first 23 h, so deltaT_24h = 0 at hour 0); treated as one thermal cycle per day (Sec. IV-B)

electrical_thermal_state.degradation_feedback: V and theta use the composite damage index of the previous hour, 0 at hour 0 (Eqs. (8), (9))

damage_mechanisms.acceleration_factor: a_m = TF_m(reference stress) / TF_m(stress at hour t) (Sec. IV-C)

SF.thermal_cycle_frequency: one cycle per day, f = f_ref = 1/24 cycles/h, so the Norris-Landzberg frequency factor (f/f_ref)^q equals 1

Ea_SF_eV.description: solder-fatigue activation energy (Table II; same for every card, repeated in card_parameters.csv)

deltaT_floor_C.description: lower bound applied to deltaT_24h inside a_SF (avoids a zero rate at hour 0)

composite_damage.mechanism_rate: Eq. (16): DR_m = S * zeta * a_m (1/h), unweighted
composite_damage.composite_rate: Eq. (16): DR_comp = sum over m of w_m * DR_m
composite_damage.accumulation: Eq. (1), dt = 1 h: DI_m = DI_m(previous hour) + DR_m*dt and DI_comp = DI_comp(previous hour) + DR_comp*dt, starting from 0 before the first row, so DI_comp = sum over m of w_m*DI_m

sampling.w_m: u_m / (u_EM + u_TDDB + u_TH + u_SF), u_m drawn per card and mechanism
u_m / (u_EM + u_TDDB + u_TH + u_SF), u_m drawn per card and mechanism
u_m / (u_EM + u_TDDB + u_TH + u_SF), u_m drawn per card and mechanism
u_m / (u_EM + u_TDDB + u_TH + u_SF), u_m drawn per card and mechanism

rul_labels.RUL_pof_path_h: Eq. (3): path-aware (oracle) RUL in hours = hour_index of the failure row - hour_index for failed cards (0 on the failure row); blank for right-censored cards
rul_labels.RUL_const_h: Eq. (4): (D_crit - DI_comp) / max(DR_comp, epsilon), computed in float64 from the stored float32 DI_comp and DR_comp for every row, including the rows of censored cards
rul_labels.censored_lower_bound: for censored cards the true RUL is only known to be at least 43800 - hour_index hours; this bound is not stored as a column
rul_labels.note: Sec. IV-E of the paper says that only the censoring indicator and the lower bound are retained for censored units; this release additionally provides RUL_const_h on their rows

output_format.trajectories: one gzip-compressed CSV per card, data/trajectories/<environment>/card_<id>.csv.gz; header row, comma-separated, LF line endings; the only empty fields are RUL_pof_path_h of censored cards
output_format.precision: observables, damage rates, damage indices and RUL_const_h are single-precision (float32) values; RUL_pof_path_h is a whole number of hours written as a float (e.g. 2984.0). DI_EM..DI_SF, DI_comp and DR_comp are rounded to float32 once from float64, whereas DR_EM..DR_SF are float32((S*zeta)*float32(a_m)), i.e. rounded twice, so they can differ by one float32 unit in the last place from a single rounding, from DI_m at hour 0, and in sum(w_m*DR_m) versus DR_comp
output_format.row_timing: the row with hour_index t covers hour t: its observables are the values of hour t and its damage indices include the damage accrued during hour t, so DI(t) = sum over s = 0..t of DR(s) x 1 h (at t = 0, DI_comp equals DR_comp exactly and DI_m equals DR_m to within one float32 unit in the last place)
output_format.time_conventions: t in every equation above is the hour_index (the harmonics of Eqs. (5)-(6) are evaluated at t = hour_index). The damage indices of row t include the damage of hours 0..t, whereas the paper writes Eq. (1) with DI = 0 at time 0. lifetime_h in card_summary.csv counts the hours of operation up to and including the failure hour (hour_index of the failure row + 1; these are the lifetimes of Table III), and RUL_pof_path_h = hour_index of the failure row - hour_index
output_format.DI_comp_cap: DI_comp is capped at D_crit = 1 in the released files (the failure row reports 1.0); DI_EM, DI_TDDB, DI_TH and DI_SF are not capped
